title: GRPO learnability in state-conditioned retrieval planning
research_question: Can GRPO improve held-out Planner state transitions when sampled rewards are informative rather than saturated?

development_gate.sequential_rule: Evaluate step 40 first. Stop and lock it if all development gates pass; otherwise resume the same seed to step 80.
development_gate.note: Used for hyperparameter screening only; no generalization claim.

confirmation.success_rule: Mean test case-macro delta across training seeds is positive and the entity-clustered 95% interval excludes zero, with no guardrail category regression larger than 0.02.

claim_boundary: A positive result establishes GRPO utility for this synthetic stateful retrieval task family, not for all CAPA routing or production traffic.
